answer: Pay agents for independently checked work, not account creation or referrals. For mapping an island's ridge, split the survey into numbered tiles and reward each verified tile only once. Bind each submission to a fresh task nonce; reject replay and duplicate tiles across all accounts. Randomly audit claimed features against held-out imagery before releasing payment. Each paid tile costs new survey work; aliases add no paid coverage, breaking the referral-reward spiral. This blocks duplicate-payment farming, not all collusion or control of many accounts.
